children: Overview
UK neuroscience technology firm's H1 2026 revenue rose 16% yr/yr to £5.0 mln
Adjusted EBITDA loss for H1 improved to £0.3 mln from £0.4 mln
Company completed £2.6 mln fundraising in July and repaid debt, now debt-free
Outlook
Company sees FY 2026 revenue of not less than £10 mln
Company expects significant revenue growth in 2026 despite £0.7 mln revenue deferred to 2027
Company says pipeline of new business opportunities is deep and broad for year-end and beyond
Result Drivers
CORE SEGMENT GROWTH - Revenue growth was driven by increased activity in clinical studies and academic research, per company
NEW MARKET PILOTS - First revenues from Healthcare and Consumer Wellness pilots contributed to overall growth, per company
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY - Completion of major software platform upgrade enabled improved operational effectiveness and gross margin, per company

Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Cambridge Cognition Holdings PLC is GBp57.00, about 103.6% above its September 15 closing price of GBp28.00
The stock recently traded at 345 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 144 three months ago
